description: Phase-2: 2.9B BiRWKV diffusion conversion (code/plan Phase 2). Warm-start Goose-2.9B into dual-direction denoiser (parity gate first, fail-closed, per host). Staged unfreeze: <5% steps reverse+fusion only, <15% + top-half forward layers, then all params. 4000 steps x 1.05M tokens/step = 4.2B tokens, blend fineweb_4096_packed_full (9.4B pool) + capability_mixture_4096_packed (0.92B). Absorbing-mask noise mixture, causal replay 0.30->0.10, atomic ckpt every 250 steps, sampler metrics every 500. GATES from 0.4B pilot: bidir beat causal control by 0.97 nats val CE (2.63/3.96/5.97 vs 4.13/5.24/6.60 by bucket), em@1 0.212 vs 0.129 @70% mask -- proceeding per approved plan. Exit gates: causal replay <=5% worse than init 2.82, masked CE falls in all buckets, iterative>=single-step by end, 12h stability.
